exposure: Time interval from antenatal corticosteroids administration to delivery (<7 days vs >=7 days)
cohort: Women with twin pregnancies who received a complete course of antenatal corticosteroids and delivered before 34 weeks gestation.
finding: Newborns delivered ≥7 days after antenatal corticosteroids suffered significantly more often from respiratory disorders and were hospitalized longer, while those delivered <7 days were more often administered antibiotics.
followup_time: Up to approximately 42 days (based on length of hospitalization)
